English: Cleared Camp
A patch of jungle cleared for basic encampment, with earthworks and makeshift shelters for early defenders.
Jungle Lookout
Raised wooden platforms among the trees, manned by scouts to give warning of approaching threats.
Bamboo Palisade
A defensive wall constructed from tightly lashed bamboo, forming the first true barrier against intrusion.
Stilted Hut
Permanent wooden dwellings on stilts for officers and key garrison, resistant to floods and wildlife.
Cleared Outpost
A larger, multi-structure outpost with barracks and armories, serving as a command center for jungle defenses.
Raised Walkway
Elevated wooden walkways connect key defensive positions, improving garrison mobility and defense.
Jungle Stockade
A fortified stockade with doubled bamboo walls and reinforced gates, providing a formidable barrier in the wilderness.
Jungle Redoubt
A heavily fortified redoubt with stone and timber, built to withstand sieges and anchor the defense of the region.
Moated Compound
A fortified compound surrounded by a deep water-filled moat, integrating stone towers for archers and imposing gatehouses.
Rainforest Fortress
A grand fortress of stone and timber, dominating the jungle with multiple defensive layers, towers, and command facilities, ensuring complete control over the wild terrain.
